strings.name: Elfriede Jelinek
strings.summary: Born in Austria and trained in music, Jelinek experiments with language in poetry, novels, plays and radio work. She dismantles advertising, news and everyday discourse to criticize consumer society, gender domination and Austrian evasions of Nazi history. The Piano Teacher, Lust and The Children of the Dead are major works. She received the 1998 Büchner Prize and 2004 Nobel Prize; her forceful public criticism and unconventional drama continue to provoke debate.
